title: AI-Driven Virtual Try-On and Garment Generation System for Sustainable Indian Fashion
summary: A generative-AI fashion proposal combines virtual try-on and garment design. Lower returns, less waste, and improved artisan opportunities are intended benefits.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: A generative-AI fashion proposal combines virtual try-on and garment design. Lower returns, less waste, and improved artisan opportunities are intended benefits. Demo / proposal.
purpose: Help shoppers and designers make better garment choices with less waste.
system: AI virtual try-on and garment-generation system

ratings.reason: Shoppers and artisans are intended to receive better fit information and design opportunities.
Fashion businesses are intended to reduce returns and overproduction; no realized result is supplied.
Lower textile waste and emissions are intended environmental benefits, not measured effects.

ai_role.statement: The chapter describes this system as supporting the stated purpose. Its causal contribution to the benefit has not been separately assessed.

evidence.citation: Contributed use case in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. The reported outcomes are attributed to the submitting project, not an independent outcome evaluation by ITU.
